# Alfa Ebooks Manager

> > Comprehensive ebook and audiobook management software for organizing, editing, and syncing personal digital libraries with metadata support and Kindle integration.

Alfa Ebooks Manager is a desktop application for Windows that helps users catalog, organize, and manage ebook and audiobook collections. It offers ISBN scanning, metadata editing, format conversion, and seamless integration with Amazon Kindle devices and services.

## Key Topics

- ebook management
- audiobook player
- library software
- metadata editor
- Kindle integration
- ISBN scanning
- Calibre alternative
- import/export
- OPDS support
- book cataloging
- Windows desktop application
- CSV/Excel support
- format conversion
- personal library
- lifetime license
